extra_findings.question: Is generation deterministic on this environment?
extra_findings.method: Identical graph and seed run twice; compared file hash and decoded-pixel hash.
extra_findings.conclusion: Generation IS bit-deterministic for an identical graph. The file hashes differ only because ComfyUI embeds the prompt graph in a PNG text chunk and that graph contains the SaveImage filename_prefix, which differed between runs. Golden-image regression IS viable here, but must hash decoded pixels.
